en/chibi-cat-coloring-page.title: Chibi Cat Coloring Page
en/chibi-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Chibi Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Chibi design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/chibi-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Chibi art exaggerates the head and keeps the body proportions small.
tips: Use gentle color transitions on Chibi faces and leave tiny highlights in the eyes.
Keep clothing colors simple so the oversized head remains the main focal point.

en/cartoon-cat-coloring-page.title: Cartoon Cat Coloring Page
en/cartoon-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Cartoon Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Cartoon design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/cartoon-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Cartoon art simplifies shapes and exaggerates expressions to tell a story.
tips: Give each Cartoon shape a clear base color before adding a single darker shadow.
Choose contrasting colors for neighboring areas so the bold outlines remain easy to read.

en/realistic-cat-coloring-page.title: Realistic Cat Coloring Page
en/realistic-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Realistic Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Realistic design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/realistic-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Realistic drawing uses light, shadow and texture to suggest natural forms.
tips: Build the Realistic shading with light pencil layers, following the direction of fur or surfaces.
Keep the brightest areas white and deepen only the shadows to preserve the line details.

en/steampunk-cat-coloring-page.title: Steampunk Cat Coloring Page
en/steampunk-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Steampunk Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Steampunk design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/steampunk-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Steampunk art combines historical design influences with imagined machinery.
tips: Try brass, copper and brown tones for Steampunk details, with one cool accent color.
Shade small mechanical shapes one at a time, leaving thin highlights to suggest metal.

en/kawaii-cat-coloring-page.title: Kawaii Cat Coloring Page
en/kawaii-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Kawaii Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Kawaii design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/kawaii-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Kawaii art favors rounded shapes and simple, friendly expressions.
tips: Try two or three pastel colors for the Kawaii shapes and keep the background light.
Add a small blush with a pale pink pencil without covering the facial outlines.

en/anime-cat-coloring-page.title: Anime Cat Coloring Page
en/anime-cat-coloring-page.description: Explore this Anime Cat coloring page and its distinctive outlines. Choose colors that highlight the Anime design, then print your sheet for a relaxed creative session.
en/anime-cat-coloring-page.fact: Did you know? Anime drawings often use expressive eyes and sharp contrasts to suggest emotion.
tips: Choose a light direction before shading Anime hair, and leave narrow highlights uncolored.
Use a small palette for the main shapes, then add a darker tone beneath overlapping lines.

en/mandala-coloring-page-for-adults.title: Mandala Coloring Page for Adults
en/mandala-coloring-page-for-adults.description: Printable Mandala coloring sheet. Choose your colors and enjoy a quiet creative activity.
en/mandala-coloring-page-for-adults.fact: Did you know? Mandala designs arrange repeated shapes around a central point.
tips: Begin at the Mandala center and repeat the same colors around each ring.
Test a three-color palette on scrap paper before filling the smallest spaces.

es/kawaii-cat-coloring-page.title: Gato para colorear: estilo Kawaii

es/anime-cat-coloring-page.title: Gato para colorear: estilo Anime
